offers_products.reason: Manufactures instruments, reagents, ddPCR systems, chromatography media, diagnostic test kits and quality controls for research and clinical labs.

offers_services.reason: Revenue is from instruments, consumables and reagents; service and support only accompany products sold.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells to labs, hospitals, biopharma, universities and food testers, not individuals or households.

recurring_revenue.reason: Most revenue is repeat purchases of reagents, test kits, controls and consumables used on installed instruments.

cyclical_demand.reason: Clinical diagnostics and routine reagents are needed continuously; only some research instrument purchases are deferrable.

big_ticket.reason: Typical sales are reagents, kits and controls bought frequently, though instruments are occasional larger purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for manufactured instruments, reagents and diagnostic products, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are hospitals, large clinical labs, biopharma manufacturers, universities and government research institutions.

notes: Asset-heavy and large-customer answers are judgment calls; the text doesn't settle them.
